import math
from machine import Pin, PWM, time_pulse_us

    d.text('%.0f cm' % cm, 8, 4, d.RED if near else d.WHITE); d.show()
    if near: bz.duty_u16(20000); lab.sleep(0.05); bz.duty_u16(0)
    else: bz.duty_u16(0)

import lab

from machine import Pin
boot = Pin(0, Pin.IN, Pin.PULL_UP)     # 左鍵 BOOT：沒按=1，按下=0
key = Pin(47, Pin.IN, Pin.PULL_UP)    # 右鍵 KEY

import time, math
from machine import PWM
bz = PWM(Pin(16), freq=1200); bz.duty_u16(0)
bpm = 100; last = time.ticks_ms(); beat = 0
def draw(phase):
    d.fill(d.BLACK); d.text('%d BPM' % bpm, 36, 4, d.WHITE)
    a = math.sin(phase * math.pi) * 0.8; d.line(64, 118, int(64 + 70 * math.sin(a)), int(118 - 70 * math.cos(a)), d.YELLOW)
    d.fill_rect(54, 112, 20, 10, color(120, 80, 20)); d.text('-   +', 44, 100, color(150, 150, 150)); d.show()
while lab.running():
    if boot.value() == 0:
        bpm = max(40, bpm - 5); print('BPM', bpm)
        while lab.running() and boot.value() == 0: lab.sleep(0.02)
    if key.value() == 0:
        bpm = min(240, bpm + 5); print('BPM', bpm)
        while lab.running() and key.value() == 0: lab.sleep(0.02)
    period = 60000 // bpm; el = time.ticks_diff(time.ticks_ms(), last)
    if el >= period:
        last = time.ticks_add(last, period); beat += 1; bz.freq(1600 if beat % 4 == 0 else 1200); bz.duty_u16(25000); lab.sleep(0.03); bz.duty_u16(0); el = 0; print('拍', beat)
    draw((el / period) + (beat % 2)); lab.sleep(0.03)
